semantics.plain_nonprimitive_formal: default nonowning borrow, no implicit move or share
semantics.read_call: read(foo) ~ read(borrow! foo) under equal verified provenance
semantics.write_call: write(mut foo) requires sealed mutable param effect and exclusive permission
semantics.ambiguous: require explicit borrow! and verified provenance or reject, no guest
semantics.call_order: single evaluation in lexical source order; overlapping loans across later argument evaluation
semantics.breakage: old implicitly consuming class formals require an explicit, versioned migration; owned-formal grammar pending
semantics.cross_actor: no raw actor-local borrow crosses actor/isolate/send/await boundaries without independently proven capability
semantics.returned_borrow: Borrow<T> distinguishes borrowed result; infer result lifetime only when all returns originate from one provable borrowed parameter or self
semantics.named_lifetimes: lt! a binder (lifetime! a alias), lt=a named generic lifetime; multiple candidate return sources need explicit checked relationships
semantics.nll: lifetime last-use expiry closes loan interval but never grants the borrowed alias drop/move ownership
semantics.escape: no returned local/temporary, unproved await, actor crossing or captured escaping reference
semantics.same_call_aliasing: multiple ordinary readonly arguments to one owner create overlapping verified shared loans; no copy, move, refcount or Pointer<T> required
semantics.same_call_order: a borrow then take! of one owner in later arguments conflicts with the live loan; take! then borrow is use-after-move; diagnose before any guest output
